address: 3900 rue Éthel, Verdun, Montréal, H4G 1S4, Canada
bio: The two Argentinian brothers behind this popular neighborhood restaurant have chosen a name that pays tribute to their grandmother. But rather than limiting themselves to their Argentinian roots, they cook open-minded, contemporary cuisine drawing on Iberian-Italian influences and making use of all resources at their disposal. Good examples of this are the lightly marinated mackerel on crusty sesame bread, covered with a tangy garlic and horseradish butter, or the guinea fowl pâté with green tomato relish. The flavors are often bold, and the dishes are copious—best savored along with the fine selection of natural wines or a signature cocktail....
